analyst_view.overall: Celta (27th, 3 points) host Bournemouth (2nd, 12 points from four wins) at Balaidos. Bournemouth under Marco Rose are on a long winning run, but Alex Toth, Julian Araujo and Juanlu Sanchez are out (all in the numbers' missing list), and previews expect Eli Junior Kroupi to lead the line rather than in-form Evanilson ahead of Sunday's trip to Fulham. Celta have scored very little at home lately and Claudio Giraldez is under pressure; striker Borja Iglesias and Carl Starfelt are only training partly with the group (club update on Tuesday) and Miguel Roman is out, none of them in the numbers' missing list, while Iago Aspas is expected to start. German referee Harm Osmers books a little more than average, which the numbers count. I keep a small lean lower on goals for Celta's blunt attack and Bournemouth's likely changes up front; the rest stays with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 1.2 for Celta and 1.8 for Bournemouth, and already trim Celta for scoring only 4 in their last 6 (-4.2%). Borja Iglesias, Celta's main striker, is still only partly back in training and not in the missing list, and Bournemouth are expected to start Kroupi instead of Evanilson; much of Iglesias' absence already shows in Celta's form, so I only go mildly lower, to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners, split fairly evenly. Bournemouth's direct, wide play and Celta's wing-backs in Giraldez's 3-4-3 both produce corners, and recent corner form is already in the numbers, so rotation on either side does not clearly change this. I stay at about 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already raised 13% for referee Harm Osmers (4.5 a game) and lowered for Bournemouth's few recent bookings. Yoel Lago's ban is for Celta's league game, not this one, and nothing suggests a heated match, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots and already raise Celta for shooting a lot lately (+8.3%), even if few go in. Rotation on both sides (Kroupi for Evanilson, fresh legs for Celta before Villarreal) changes faces more than volume, so I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 on target and already cut Celta's share for poor accuracy (-9.6%), which partly reflects playing without Iglesias. Bournemouth's forward line keeps their side up even if Evanilson starts on the bench, so I stay at about 8.7.
